changeSet.author: tgms
changeSet.comment: Replace Product fake-delete DISCONTINUED rows with safe CRUD deletion while preserving Order and Quotation history through INACTIVE products and UNAVAILABLE variants. This destructive legacy cleanup is forward-only and intentionally has no rollback because deleted or converted data cannot be reconstructed.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM garment_product_variants WHERE product_id IN ( SELECT id FROM garment_products WHERE status = 'DISCONTINUED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = garment_products.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quotation_items qi WHERE qi.product_id = garment_products.id ) )

DELETE FROM garment_products WHERE status = 'DISCONTINUED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = garment_products.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quotation_items qi WHERE qi.product_id = garment_products.id )
ALTER TABLE garment_products DROP CHECK ck_garment_products_status
ALTER TABLE garment_products DROP CONSTRAINT ck_garment_products_status
ALTER TABLE garment_products ADD CONSTRAINT ck_garment_products_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
ALTER TABLE garment_product_variants DROP CHECK ck_garment_product_variants_status
ALTER TABLE garment_product_variants DROP CONSTRAINT ck_garment_product_variants_status
ALTER TABLE garment_product_variants ADD CONSTRAINT ck_garment_product_variants_status CHECK (status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'UNAVAILABLE'))
